location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, student lounge
location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，學生交誼廳

goal.en: Invite Leo to go hiking this weekend and set a time to meet.
goal.zh: 邀里歐這個週末去健行，並約好碰面時間。

background: bright student lounge at a language school with colorful beanbags, a long wooden table, potted plants, tall windows showing green trees, late afternoon sunlight

intro.en: Friday afternoon. Class is over, and the forecast for Saturday is sunny and warm.
intro.zh: 星期五下午，課上完了，星期六的天氣預報是晴朗又溫暖。

intro.en: You have wanted to try a hiking trail near Maple Bay for weeks. Leo is packing up his bag.
intro.zh: 你想去楓灣附近的一條登山步道已經好幾個禮拜了。里歐正在收書包。

lines.en: Hey, Kai! Finally, the weekend. Any plans?
lines.zh: 嘿，凱！終於週末了。有什麼計畫嗎？

choices.en: Not really. Are you free on Saturday?
choices.zh: 還沒有耶。你星期六有空嗎？
choices.tip: 約人之前先用 Are you free on + 星期幾? 確認對方有沒有空。

choices.en: Not really. Saturday you have empty?
choices.zh: 還沒有。星期六你有空嗎？

lines.en: I have... empty? Empty what? My wallet?
lines.zh: 我有……空？空什麼？我的錢包嗎？

story.en: Leo laughs and thinks you are joking about money. By the time you explain, he has already agreed to a video game marathon with his host brother.
story.zh: 里歐笑出來，以為你在開錢的玩笑。等你解釋清楚，他已經答應寄宿家庭的弟弟要打一整天電動了。

fail.why: 「有空」不能翻成 have empty。英文說人有空用 free：Are you free on Saturday? 也可以問 Do you have time on Saturday?。

choices.en: Not really. Are you free in Saturday?
choices.zh: 還沒有。你星期六有空嗎？

lines.en: In Saturday? Is Saturday a place now?
lines.zh: 在星期六裡面？星期六變成一個地方了嗎？

story.en: Leo starts a long joke about living inside Saturday. The joke goes on until his bus comes, and you never get to ask him.
story.zh: 里歐開始講一個「住在星期六裡」的長篇笑話，一路講到他的公車來，你始終沒機會開口約他。

fail.why: 星期幾前面的介系詞用 on：on Saturday、on Friday night。in 用在月份、年份或 in the morning。正確說法是 Are you free on Saturday?。

lines.en: Saturday? Yeah, I'm free all day. Why?
lines.zh: 星期六？有啊，我整天都有空。怎麼了？

choices.en: Do you want to go hiking with me?
choices.tip: Do you want to + 原形動詞? 是朋友之間最自然的邀約句。

choices.en: Do you want to climb mountain with me?

lines.en: Climb a mountain? With ropes and helmets? I'm scared of heights!
lines.zh: 攀登一座山？要繩子跟頭盔那種嗎？我有懼高症耶！

story.en: Leo pictures ropes, ice and cliffs, and politely says no. You spend Saturday on the trail alone, wondering what went wrong.
story.zh: 里歐腦中浮現繩索、冰雪和懸崖，客氣地拒絕了你。星期六你一個人走在步道上，想不通哪裡出了錯。

fail.why: 中文的「爬山」直翻成 climb a mountain，聽起來像要攀岩登頂。一般走步道說 go hiking：Do you want to go hiking?。

choices.en: You're coming hiking with me. No excuses!
choices.zh: 你要跟我去健行，不准找藉口！

lines.en: Whoa, okay, boss. Do I even get a choice?
lines.zh: 哇，好喔，老闆。我有選擇的權利嗎？

story.en: Leo agrees, but he looks like he is going to the dentist. The whole hike feels like a school trip nobody wanted.
story.zh: 里歐是答應了，但表情像要去看牙醫。整趟健行像一場沒人想參加的校外教學。

fail.why: 用命令句邀約，聽起來像在下指令，對方會覺得沒有拒絕的空間。用問句 Do you want to...? 或 Would you like to...? 讓對方自己決定。

lines.en: Hiking? I'm in! Where do you want to go?
lines.zh: 健行？算我一份！你想去哪裡？

choices.en: How about Cedar Hill? The view is amazing.
choices.zh: 去雪松山怎麼樣？那裡的風景超美。
choices.tip: How about + 地點? 用來提議，後面補一句理由更有說服力。

choices.en: Yes, I want to go somewhere.

lines.zh: 好喔……可是「某個地方」是哪裡？

story.en: Leo waits for a name, but none comes. You two scroll through maps for twenty minutes and never decide.
story.zh: 里歐等你說出地名，結果什麼也沒等到。你們滑了二十分鐘地圖，還是沒決定要去哪。

fail.why: Where 問的是地點，要直接說出地方，不能用 Yes 回答。可以說 How about Cedar Hill? 或 Let's go to Cedar Hill.。

choices.en: How about go to Cedar Hill? It's very beautiful.
choices.zh: 去雪松山怎麼樣？那裡很漂亮。

lines.en: How about go? You mean "going"? Our teacher would circle that in red!
lines.zh: How about go？你是說 going 吧？老師一定會用紅筆圈起來！

story.en: Leo spends the rest of the break playing grammar teacher. You get a free lesson, but still no plan.
story.zh: 接下來整個下課時間，里歐都在扮演文法老師。你上了一堂免費的課，但行程還是沒排好。

fail.why: How about 後面接名詞或動名詞（V-ing），不能接原形動詞。要說 How about going to Cedar Hill? 或更簡單的 How about Cedar Hill?。

lines.en: Cedar Hill! I've always wanted to go there.
lines.zh: 雪松山！我一直很想去那裡。

lines.en: So, nine o'clock at Maple Bay Station?
lines.zh: 那就九點在楓灣車站碰面？

choices.tip: Sounds great! 是答應提議最自然的回應，再用 See you there. 收尾。

lines.zh: 哇。是你約我的耶，記得嗎？

story.en: Leo still comes on Saturday, but he walks five steps ahead of you all the way up the hill.
story.zh: 里歐星期六還是來了，但整條上山的路，他都走在你前面五步遠。

fail.why: Fine, whatever. 聽起來很不耐煩，像是被逼著答應。自己邀約的事更要表現期待：Sounds great! See you there.。

choices.en: Nine is too late. Let's meet at five!
choices.zh: 九點太晚了，我們五點見！

lines.en: Five? In the morning? On a Saturday?
lines.zh: 五點？早上五點？星期六耶？

story.en: Leo agrees, then sleeps through four alarms. You watch the sunrise alone, holding two sandwiches.
story.zh: 里歐答應了，結果睡過四個鬧鐘。你一個人看日出，手裡拿著兩份三明治。

fail.why: 台灣很多人習慣清晨就去爬山，但在楓灣，週末約五點出發不是常態，直接否定對方提的時間也有點強勢。時間可以接受就說 Sounds great!，想提早可以問 Could we meet a bit earlier?。

lines.en: Saturday morning. The sky over Cedar Hill is clear and blue.
lines.zh: 星期六早上，雪松山的天空湛藍無雲。

lines.en: Kai, look at this view! Thanks for inviting me.
lines.zh: 凱，你看這風景！謝謝你約我。

story.en: You and Leo eat sandwiches at the top and plan your next hike before you even walk down.
story.zh: 你和里歐在山頂吃三明治，還沒下山就已經在計畫下一次健行了。

notes.explain: 邀約前先確認對方有沒有空。星期幾和日期前面用 on，例如 on Friday night、on May 5th。

example.en: Are you free on Sunday afternoon?

notes.en: Do you want to go hiking?
notes.explain: Do you want to + 原形動詞? 是朋友之間最常用的邀約句。想更客氣可以說 Would you like to...?。

example.en: Do you want to grab lunch after class?
example.zh: 下課後要不要一起吃午餐？

notes.explain: How about 用來提議，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞。

example.en: How about going to the beach instead?

notes.en: go hiking, not climb a mountain
notes.explain: 中文的「爬山」直翻成 climb a mountain，聽起來像要攀岩登頂。走步道說 go hiking 或 go for a hike。

example.en: We went hiking at Cedar Hill last weekend.
example.zh: 我們上週末去雪松山健行。

notes.explain: 答應邀約或提議最自然的回應，也可以說 Sounds good! 或 I'm in!。

example.zh: 今晚吃披薩？聽起來很棒！
